---
# nocite: '@*' prints every entry in references.bib, not just the cited ones.
# NIH's References Cited has no page limit, but it must list what you cite.
# If you'd rather list only cited works, delete this line — then the sections
# that cite them must be rendered as part of the same document.
nocite: '@*'
format:
  pdf:
    output-file: 90-references.pdf
---

# References Cited

<!-- The bibliography is injected here. Body sections set
     `suppress-bibliography: true` so citations resolve there without each
     section printing its own reference list. filters/refs-no-links.lua strips
     hyperlinks from the entries. -->
